Inspection / Maintenance Item: Is the Manufacturer's Data Plate secured and legible?
Is the data plate free of corrosion?
Is the pressure rating proper for the product?
Are containers free of excessive corrosion damage, dents, gouges or other damage?
Are all container markings and decals in accordance with NFPA 58?
Are containers/saddles free of corrosion at masonry contact areas?
Are saddle pads in good condition?
Are all container openings (except relief valve connections) equipped with proper fixed restriction, back check, or internal valves and shutoff valves?
Are connections on containers greater than 2,000 gallon water capacity marked "vapor" or "liquid"?
